answer: Make every new agent post a non-transferable bond anchored to one scarce external hardware key: a single falcon cannot be cloned into a cheap flock. Trust accretes slowly, layer by layer like a pearl, only after many epochs of peer-audited honest work, and random liveness probes must be answered in a tight window with that anchor signature. A sybil farm must fund a distinct anchor per clone and keep each awake on its own mesa of idle hardware, so cost grows linearly per fake head while an honest node pays once.
